title: CallLint Safe-Install Result
description: The machine-readable result envelope (calllint.safe-install-result.v1) emitted by the `calllint safe-install` orchestrator and the MCP adoption tools (new14 Phase 2.4; ADR 0056 §9). Reports the OUTCOME of a local, exact-target adoption attempt — it delegates every live write to the shipped Trust Gateway apply service (the one writer; INV-2.4-03) and carries no verdict of its own (INV-2.4-01). `outcome` is a closed vocabulary; `receiptDigest`/`planDigest` bind the result to the shipped install-plan + decision-receipt objects (never a parallel 'safe-install plan' type; §4.1). One-time mode leaves zero persistent CallLint files (INV-2.4-07); persistentComponents is empty unless a separate, explicit continuous-protection authorization was granted.

schema.description: Wire identity. The tag, not the filename, is the contract (ADR 0043/0055 §5).

outcome.description: Closed outcome vocabulary. ABORTED_ON_MISMATCH = an exact-target digest/version assertion failed → no writable plan was produced (INV-2.4-06). DECLINED = the operator did not approve at the single approval gate.

canonicalName.description: The canonical tool identity this result concerns.

mode.description: The adoption mode. Default is ONE_TIME_PROTECTED_SETUP, which MUST NOT install any persistent CallLint component (INV-2.4-07).

host.description: The resolved host id when an apply was attempted; null for prepare-only / unsupported.

version.description: The exact version acted on. null only when the outcome is LOCAL_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED / UNSUPPORTED.

planDigest.description: Digest of the shipped calllint.install-plan.v1 that was applied (null unless APPLIED_AND_VERIFIED).

receiptDigest.description: Digest of the shipped decision-receipt emitted by the apply service (null unless a write occurred).

persistentComponents.description: Persistent CallLint components installed. MUST be empty in ONE_TIME_PROTECTED_SETUP mode (audited; INV-2.4-07). Each entry is enumerated with its documented uninstall command in the human transcript.

notes.description: Human-readable, non-decision notes (e.g. why a slot is empty). Never carries publisher content.
